meaning:
Baal-hamon = "lord (possessor) of abundance"
the site of Solomon's vineyard
Another spelling of cher.mon (חֶרְמוֹן "(Mount )Hermon" H2768)

elsewhere.note: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal Hamon. He leased out the vineyard to keepers. Each was to bring a thousand shekels of silver for its fruit.
